review.recommendation: Approve implementation. SEC-R5-1 is closed: draft uses only lexical path operations to reject repository-contained credential paths while allowing missing, unreadable, or malformed external files; all other commands retain full stat/realpath validation. The type guard preserves releaseError attachment for ordinary Error instances and avoids strict-mode assignment to primitive throws. The supplied 68-test run and 9/9-file suite report no regressions.
review.strongestObjection: Verification is limited to the supplied packet and reported test results. The draft check intentionally cannot detect an outside-repository symlink or path alias resolving into the repository, but credential-consuming commands still enforce realpath, symlink, descriptor-identity, ownership, and permission checks before reading credentials.
